items.title: A local factorisation criterion for a map followed by a surjection onto a flat module
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file modules.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement gives the local criterion for a map from the structure sheaf into a finite direct sum of the structure sheaf followed by a surjection onto a flat module to factor through a free module with the composite killing the first map (author lemma at source lines 2972-2990, label lemma-flat-eq). The proof (source lines 2992-3007) turns the composition being zero into the vanishing of a section of the tensor product of the ideal sheaf generated by the given functions with the module, uses the injectivity of that tensor product map coming from flatness, and then sheafifies and unwinds the relation to produce the required factorisation (proof lines 2993-3006). The passage through the tensor product with the ideal sheaf is the content. H2.
